method.value: 2D Sérsic fits in galfit with iterative masking of residual pixels >5 sigma until masks converge; structures are those exceeding largest negative residual peak; 2D Gaussian fits for structure properties

evidence.quote: we fit the galaxies with two-dimensional Sérsic profiles in galfit (cite: Peng2002; Peng2010), masking residual pixels $>$5$\sigma$ iteratively until the masks converged.

fitting.value: galfit Sérsic; Gaussian fits in image plane; ~20% median systematic error from residual structure

evidence.quote: Based on two-dimensional Gaussian fits in the image plane, these structures individually make up a few percent ($\sim$1–8%) of the total continuum emission

evidence.quote: half-light radii consistent with, and Sérsic indices that are on-average slightly higher than, those derived without the masking procedure

findings_qualitative.value: Dust emission is disk-dominated with sub-kpc structures; ALMA emission is more compact than HST and offset from it

evidence.quote: We report evidence for robust sub-kpc structure on underlying exponential disks.

findings_qualitative.value: No SMG exceeds the radiation-pressure Eddington limit on ~500 pc scales

evidence.quote: even on 500 pc scales, they do not exceed the Eddington limit set by radiation pressure on dust

claims.hypothesis: Do SMG dust disks host sub-kpc structure?
claims.experiment: 0.07" 870 um imaging plus galfit Sérsic subtraction
claims.result: 1–5 residual structures per source at ~4–15 sigma, sizes up to ~1.1 kpc, 2–20% of flux
claims.finding: Sub-kpc structures exist within exponential disks but are not the dominant star formation sites

evidence.quote: between 1–5 residual structures are identified in each source at peak SNRs ranging from $\sim$4–15$\sigma$

claims.hypothesis: Are the morphologies suggestive of bars, rings and spiral arms?
claims.experiment: Examine curvature and clump pairs; measure ring/bar radii
claims.result: Ring/bar ratio 1.9±0.3, agreeing with local OLR/CR

evidence.quote: the ratio of the ‘ring’ and ‘bar’ radii (1.9$\pm$0.3) agrees with that measured for such features in local galaxies

claims.hypothesis: Do SMGs reach the Eddington limit at 500 pc?
claims.experiment: Sigma_SFR maps compared with ~650 Msun/yr/kpc^2 limit and local U/LIRGs
claims.finding: SMGs sustain high Sigma_SFR over larger scales but remain sub-Eddington at 500 pc

evidence.loc: 4.1 The intensity of the star formation
evidence.quote: none of the SMGs exceed this limit, even on the resolved scales probed here
